subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Doctors, symptoms, and tests still matter.”?
options: But when dealing with humans, a prediction must leave space for story.
Technology can notice signals, but humans must decide what action to take.
The hospital learned that technology works best when it gives humans more time to be human.
Sometimes it takes visitors to make people notice what they already have.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Doctors, symptoms, and tests still matter. Technology can notice signals, but humans must decide what action to take.」，答案為「Technology can notice signals, but humans must decide what action to take.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Technology can notice signals, but humans must decide what action to take.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
